caseNameFull: A. J. Thigpen and A. J. Thigpen, Jr. v. Midland Oil Company
attorneys: Mr. Frank McCoy,, with whom Messrs. Elmer E. Grin-stead and /. R. Speilman were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error., Messrs. J. W. Finley, Hayes McCoy, George A. Henshaw, Samuel N. Hawkés, and A. C. Hough were on the brief for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed for want of finality in the judgment of the court below, on the authority of Keike v. United States, 217 U. S. 423, 429. Application for certiorari also denied.
